Definition: a netting (ornament to the capital of a column)
BiblicalUsage: Here is sâbâk: it means a netting (ornament to the capital of a column). It stands in 1 Kings 7:17: "nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put sâbâk here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
